## Environment variables

### `BRANCHES`

Branch codes, OCCURS 1 TO 8 of PIC X(4)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `list` (list of strings) |
| Required | no |
| Secret | no |
| Default | none: unset unless the platform sets it |
| Constraints | between 1 and 8 items; each item between 2 and 4 characters (Unicode code points) |
| Wire format | the items joined by `,` with nothing around it, such as `a,b` |
| In a values file | a list of strings, such as `[a, b]`; docuconf writes it in the wire format |
| Sources | `literal`, `injected` |
| Boot errors | `invalid_type`, `out_of_range`, `too_few_items`, `too_many_items` |

### `CALLBACK_URL`

Where to report the run, PIC X(40)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `url` (URL) |
| Required | no |
| Secret | no |
| Default | none: unset unless the platform sets it |
| Constraints | at most 40 characters (Unicode code points); `https` URL |
| Wire format | an absolute URL, `scheme://...`, as is |
| In a values file | a string |
| Sources | `literal`, `configMapKeyRef`, `injected` |
| Boot errors | `invalid_type`, `out_of_range`, `invalid_scheme` |

### `LIMITS`

Run limits as JSON, PIC X(35)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|

| Required | no |
| Secret | no |
| Default | none: unset unless the platform sets it |

| In a values file | a JSON value (written as YAML or JSON in the values file) |
| Sources | `literal`, `configMapKeyRef`, `injected` |
| Boot errors | `invalid_type`, `out_of_range` |

## Sources

Where the platform may get each input from, as named in the tables above. A secret comes only from a secret store or an injector.

- `literal`: a literal value in the platform's values file
- `injected`: supplied when the container starts by an injector (`injected`), such as Bank-Vaults, `op run` or the Vault Agent injector; checked at boot
- `configMapKeyRef`: a key of a ConfigMap (`configMapKeyRef`), checked at boot

## Boot errors

At boot the SDK checks every input and reports all problems together, one line each, with one of these codes. Secret values never appear in the messages.

| Code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_type` | The value does not parse as the input's type in its wire format, or a secret still holds an unresolved injector reference (`vault:`, `op://`, `ref+`). | Write the value in the input's wire format. For an injected secret, make sure the injector runs. |
| `out_of_range` | A number, duration, length, list item or key is outside the input's bounds; an empty key always is. | Use a value within the input's constraints. |
| `invalid_scheme` | The URL's scheme is not one of the allowed schemes. | Use a URL with an allowed scheme. |
| `too_few_items` | The list has fewer items than its minimum, or the key set fewer keys. | Add items, or keys. |
| `too_many_items` | The list has more items than its maximum, or the key set more keys. | Remove items, or keys: a key set holds the old key only until the rotation is done. |
